name: gpkit_harbor4
cmd:
O=$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/out/gpkit_harbor4; mkdir -p $O
python3 decor_build.py -- --theme harbor --out $O --fine --tex 2048 --ao 24 --shots $O/shots --each > $O/build.log 2>&1 || (tail -40 $O/build.log; exit 1)
grep '^\[kit\]' $O/build.log | tail -4; rm -f $O/kit_hi.blend
